subject: science
passage: Mesosaurus was a small reptile that lived about 280 million years ago. Its fossils have been found in southern Africa and in eastern South America but nowhere in between. Studies of its skeleton and of the rocks where it was buried indicate that it lived in fresh or slightly salty coastal waters and was not built for long journeys across the open sea. Today, the two regions where its fossils appear are separated by thousands of kilometers of the South Atlantic Ocean. These findings suggest that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: southern Africa and South America were probably once joined.
choices.B: Mesosaurus regularly swam across the South Atlantic Ocean.
choices.C: Mesosaurus must have lived on every southern continent.
choices.D: the South Atlantic was much saltier when Mesosaurus lived.

explanation.why: Mesosaurus could not cross an open ocean, yet its fossils are found on both sides of the South Atlantic. The most logical explanation is that the two regions were connected, or much closer together, when it lived.
explanation.A: Correct. An animal unable to cross the open sea could live in both places only if the land was once connected.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The text says Mesosaurus was not built for long journeys across the open sea.
explanation.C: Incorrect. Its fossils are found only in southern Africa and South America, so the text does not support every southern continent.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The text gives no information about how salty the ancient ocean was.
